title: Sermon on the Mount & the Cross

questions.prompt: Beatitude / Greek makarios in the Sermon points to:
choices: A Deep happiness/blessedness (not mere shallow mood).

questions.prompt: "Blessed are the meek" links to freedom from domination by:
choices: A Power as a false ultimate.

questions.prompt: "Pure of heart," with Kierkegaard's help, means a life about:
Jesus intensifies "eye for an eye" toward:
choices: A Creative non-retaliation that exposes and transforms the aggressor.

questions.prompt: God as hesed / love means, classically for Barron:
choices: A Willing the good of the other as other.
B Using others for self-righteous return.
questions.explain: Love = will the good of the other.
